zh: SPD：决定流量处置的策略库。
SAD：已建立 SA 的参数库。
PAD：把对端授权连到 SPD 的库。
ESP：提供加密的封装安全载荷。
en: SA: a simplex security association in one direction.
SPD: policy database deciding traffic disposition.
SAD: parameters of each established SA.
PAD: links peer authorization to the SPD.
ESP: Encapsulating Security Payload offering confidentiality.
